Quarq

LongMemEval 上的 98.2%：我们如何构建一个真正能记住的开源代理

在过去的一个月里，我们专注于一个单一目标：构建一个能够持续学习的代理。Quarq Agent 是我们朝着这一愿景迈出的第一步。


基准测试运行现已完成，系统达到了 LongMemEval-S 98.2%。以下分项说明更清晰地展示了系统在不同基准测试类别中的性能表现。

概述

Quarq Agent，由 QuarqLabs 开发的以记忆为优先的 AI 代理，得分 98.2% 在 LongMemEval-S 上使用完全本地的 FAISS 向量存储和分层记忆架构。

该架构结合了：

  • HyDE 查询扩展
  • 时间真理协议
  • 定量保真度规则
  • Self-correcting two-pass retrieval
  • Three specialized LLMs instead of one

The system uses three memory layers:

  • 语义记忆： 事件和交互历史（发生了什么、何时发生、涉及谁）
  • 程序性记忆: 行为和操作规则
  • 情景记忆: 对话式和情境化的经历

GitHub：

github.com/quarqlabs/agent-oss

Results

We achieved 98.2% on LongMemEval-S.. And our detailed performance on each type of question are as follows:

These metrics represent the current LongMemEval-S progress while Quarq Agent is actively being improved. Some answers may change as failing or uncertain questions are rerun and fixes are added.


所有结果均使用 LongMemEval-S 数据集：

  • 500 questions
  • ~57M token 的对话数据
  • ~ 每个问题 50 会话

The memory system must correctly answer questions spanning all sessions.

Evaluation Pipeline

  1. Wipe all memories
  2. Feed haystack sessions in chunks (8 messages each), with background learning enabled
  3. Synchronize pending learning before the final question
  4. Ask the benchmark question with learning disabled
  5. Judge the response using GPT-5 with reasoning_effort="medium" as a binary evaluator

Configuration

Leaderboard Comparison

Notable Observations

  • Quarq Agent 使用了一个能力较弱的生成模型（gpt-4.1） 比许多排行榜条目（gpt-5-mini、gemini-3-pro-preview）
  • 时间推理是最难的基准测试类别，而 Quarq 的时间真实性协议直接针对最常见的故障模式：混淆存储时间和事件时间
  • Quarq 是本地优先并且在本地使用 FAISS，而几乎所有竞争系统都依赖于云向量数据库

How It Works

Three Specialized Models

Most memory systems use a single LLM for:

  • retrieval
  • generation
  • memory management

Quarq separates these concerns into specialized roles.

Retrieval Planner (gpt-4o-mini)

Before every search, the planner generates a structured retrieval strategy optimized for memory recall.

Instead of relying on a single embedding query, it expands the search into multiple semantically related formulations, extracts important keywords, and selects an appropriate retrieval mode based on the complexity of the question.

这使用了 HyDE（假设文档嵌入） 查询扩展以提高召回率，超越简单的向量相似度搜索。

Generator (gpt-4.1)

The generator receives:

  • retrieved memories
  • procedural rules
  • conversation history

It focuses only on response generation.

Learning Model (gpt-4.1)

The learner does not dump raw text into storage.

Instead, it performs targeted edits:

  • adding new facts
  • updating outdated facts
  • deleting contradictions

It also receives cross-type context to reduce duplication and maintain consistency across memory layers.

Hybrid Retrieval

Each retrieval pass combines:

  • vector similarity search
  • keyword search
  • metadata filtering
  • temporal validation

Two retrieval modes are used:

Temporal Truth Protocol

One of the hardest problems in long-term memory systems is temporal reasoning.

Quarq separates four independent time concepts:

  1. 存储日期： 内存保存时
  2. 事件日期： 事件实际发生的时间
  3. 叙述日期： 模拟基准测试时间线
  4. 相对日期： 在检索过程中动态解析

The rules are hard-coded:

  • never use bracketed timestamps as event dates
  • never infer dates from neighboring memories
  • never assume unrelated memories refer to the same entity
  • always resolve “how long ago” relative to the actual event

Self-Correcting Two-Pass Retrieval

If the initial retrieval pass does not provide enough evidence to answer confidently, the generator can explicitly request additional retrieval using targeted fallback queries.

The runtime then:

  1. Runs secondary searches using a broader deep retrieval threshold (0.28)
  2. Merges the newly retrieved memories with the original context
  3. Regenerates the response under stricter anti-hallucination constraints

This creates a self-correcting two-pass retrieval system where the model can request better evidence instead of fabricating missing context.

Quantitative Fidelity

Long-memory benchmarks punish sloppy numerical reasoning.

For totals, durations, prices, quantities, and counts, Quarq explicitly identifies:

  • actor or entity
  • measured action
  • target event or object
  • required exactness

The system excludes merely nearby or topically related numbers and only aggregates values that satisfy exact-match constraints.

Background Learning

Learning runs asynchronously after every response to minimize user-facing latency.

Safeguards include:

  • semaphore limit of 4 concurrent learning tasks
  • persistent retry with exponential backoff
  • synchronization barriers during benchmark evaluation

What the Benchmark Actually Tests

  1. 检索记忆： 系统能否从特定的过去交互中调取信息
  2. generate_response: 能否使用检索到的记忆正确回答？
  3. single-session-assistant: 它能记住用户随意提到的偏好吗？
  4. 知识更新 ：它能否正确解决时间顺序和演化状态？
  5. 多会话 ：它能否随时间在多个对话中进行推理？

Architecture Evolution

The earliest version of Quarq used raw flat .txt files loaded into context on every request.

It worked poorly, but exposed an important constraint:

A single LLM cannot simultaneously optimize for retrieval quality, generation quality, and cost efficiency.

The architecture evolved through several iterations:

Each major component emerged from a specific failure mode:

  • HyDE 查询扩展来自于观察到单向量检索会遗漏相关记忆
  • Temporal Truth 协议来自于时间幻觉，比如回答“三周前”而不是“昨天”
  • 双轮回退检索源于模型自信地编造答案而非承认上下文不足

Open-Sourcing the Benchmark Runner

Alongside Quarq Agent, we are also open-sourcing the benchmark runner used for our LongMemEval-S evaluations.

The repository runs the agent against the benchmark through a clean HTTP-based evaluation pipeline.

The benchmark runner is intentionally separated from the agent runtime. It communicates with a running agent-oss FastAPI server over HTTP instead of importing the agent code directly.

This makes the evaluation process easier to reproduce and inspect independently.

基准测试代码仓库：

https://github.com/quarqlabs/benchmarks

The repository also includes:

  • cleaned LongMemEval-S dataset integration
  • checkpointed evaluation runs
  • retrieved-context logging
  • per-question memory isolation
  • parallel evaluation support
  • cost and token accounting guidance

The goal is reproducible long-memory evaluation with transparent runtime behavior rather than opaque leaderboard claims.

Getting Started

Quarq Agent is open source and available now.

Clone the Repository

git clone https://github.com/quarqlabs/agent-oss
cd agent-oss
python-m venv .venv &&source .venv/bin/activate
pip install-r requirements.txt

Create a .env File

OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...
USER_ID=local_user
AGENT_ID=my_agent

Run the Terminal Agent

python agent.py

Run the API Server

uvicorn main:app--reload
curl-X POST <http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/chat> \\
-H"Content-Type: application/json" \\
-d'{"prompt": "What do you remember about me?"}'

Reproduce the Benchmark

python run_dataset_evals.py

Parallel Evaluation

EVAL_WORKERS=4 python run_dataset_evals_parallel.py

Conclusion

Quarq Agent 实现了在 LongMemEval-S 上达到 98.2% 采用了围绕长期记忆推理设计的本地优先架构。

The architecture is intentionally simple:

  • three specialized LLMs
  • HyDE query expansion
  • hybrid FAISS + keyword retrieval
  • strict temporal reasoning
  • quantitative fidelity rules
  • self-correcting two-pass retrieval

Everything is open source under Apache 2.0.

代码仓库:

github.com/quarqlabs/agent-oss
